summary: The primary meaning of QRY relates to collecting or gathering water, often in a basin or reservoir.

headwords.def: اِفْتَرَى [meaning تَتَبَّعَ : see a verse of Aboo Dhu-eyb, voce خَافَةٌ , in art. خوف .] It also means He investigated a country or countries. (S, * K, * TA, all in art. قرى ; and TA in art. قرو .) He made much and diligent search. (KL.) See also 10 in art. قرأ .

tank, for the drinking of beasts:

headwords.def: قِرًى Entertainment for a guest; that with which a guest is entertained. (S.) Water collected in a trough, or tank, for the drinking of beasts: see بَيُّوتٌ : thus explained in the M in art. بيت .

headwords.gloss: A place where water runs; to; in
headwords.def: قَرِىٌّ A place where water runs, (T, S,) to, (T,) or in, or into, (S,) meadows, (T,) or a meadow. (S.) See شَيْخٌ (last sentence). Pl. أَقْرِيَةٌ : see قَرْءٌ .

parts.t: unless qualified by an epithet denoting greatness. (TA in art.

headwords.def: قَرْيَةٌ A town, or village; (Msb, TA;) a small بَلَد , smaller than a مَدِينَة : (MF, voce تِرْمِذ :) not well applied to a مَدِينَة unless qualified by an epithet denoting greatness. (TA in art. مَدِينَة .) See Bd, ii. 261.
نَاقَةٌ فِى قِرْوَتِهَا : see 4 in art. قرأ .

headwords.gloss: yard of a ship; a squared piece of wood upon the head of the mast of a ship

parts.t: a squared piece of wood upon the head of the mast of a ship.

headwords.def: قَرِيَّةٌ [vulg. قَرْيَة The yard of a ship; ] a squared piece of wood upon the head of the mast of a ship. (Az, TA in art. رنح .)
قَارِيَهٌ A certain bird. See خُضَارِىٌّ and تَنَوُّطٌ .
نَاقَةٌ قَرْوَاءُ A long-backed she-camel. (IB, in TA, voce هِرْجَابٌ .)
مَقْرُوٌّ and مَقْرِىٌّ for مَقْرُوْءٌ : see art. قرأ .
